task.title: Permanently delete a profile
task.shortdesc: Remove an active or archived profile only after confirming that it should not be retained.

prereq.p: The profile row is visible and you have confirmed that the profile is no longer needed.

context.p: Permanent delete is the destructive Library lifecycle action. Archive first when you need a reversible hold.

step.cmd: Confirm the row name, ID, schema, lifecycle state, and updated time.

info.p: Expected result: you can distinguish the target profile from similarly named rows.

info.note: Permanent delete cannot be restored from the Library.

step.cmd: Complete the confirmation only when the prompt names the intended profile.

info.p: Cancel the confirmation if any row detail is unexpected.

result.p: The profile is removed from the Library after the delete action succeeds.

postreq.p: Recovery: if deletion fails, do not repeat immediately; refresh and use the troubleshooting topic to inspect the status.
